skill_title: Read bank statements and calculate fees
notes: 20-item bank, Grade 12 only. CAPS mix: 5 L1 / 8 L2 / 7 L3. Bank fee schedules: monthly account fee, per-transaction fees, withdrawal fees.

| Card swipe | 0,00 |

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DOCUMENT_FIELD: Reads the wrong row from a fee schedule or statement.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DEBIT_CREDIT_COLUMN: Reads the wrong column on a statement.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BAND_BOUNDARY: Doesn't apply free-transactions allowance before charged transactions begin.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_USE_OPERATION: Uses the wrong operation when applying a per-transaction rate.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_PERIODIC: Forgets to convert annual rate to monthly when needed.
